definitions.gloss: component stereo system; home audio system
definitions.explanation: A home audio system, especially a compact one combining a tuner, amplifier, CD player, and speakers. Short for コンポーネントステレオ.

examples.japanese: {部屋|へや}にコンポを{置|お}いた。
examples.english: I put a stereo system in my room.

examples.japanese: {学生|がくせい}のころ{安|やす}いミニコンポを{買|か}った。
examples.english: When I was a student, I bought a cheap compact stereo.

examples.japanese: {最近|さいきん}はスマホで{音楽|おんがく}を{聞|き}くので、コンポを{使|つか}う{人|ひと}は{減|へ}った。
examples.english: These days people listen to music on their phones, so fewer people use a stereo system.

notes:
Short for コンポーネントステレオ. Originally referred to a system assembled from separate components; now often a single compact unit.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ミニコンポ: a compact stereo system
- コンポで{音楽|おんがく}を{聞|き}く: to listen to music on a stereo

USAGE:
ミニコンポ, a small all-in-one system, was very popular in the 1980s-2000s. The word now feels somewhat dated as smartphones and streaming have taken over.
